article.title: My favorite new music releases of 2010
article.excerpt: For classical releases I thought this was a stunning year, but a mediocre year in a lot of other categories. I do however have a few (non-classical) favorites: Timbuktu Tarab , by Khaira Arby ; from Mali, intense. Sikilela , by Amabutho; from South Africa.
